props.name: targetRef
props.description: The field the words go into, at the caret.

props.name: lang
props.description: BCP 47 language of the speech, e.g. `en-GB`. Defaults to the page language.

props.name: continuous
props.description: Keep listening across pauses until pressed again. Off stops after one phrase.

props.name: onTranscript
props.description: Called with each finished phrase, after it is inserted.

props.name: unsupportedMessage
props.defaultValue: 'Dictation is not available in this browser. Try Chrome, Edge or Safari.'
props.description: Shown instead of the button where speech recognition does not exist. `null` renders nothing.
